title: Single-Origin Cacao: Sourcing Directly From Ecuadorian Smallholders
excerpt: Fair-trade relationships that bring deep floral notes and ethical sourcing to our chocolate ganache.
content: Our dark chocolate does not come from industrial conglomerate pellets. We partner directly with three family cooperative farms in the Esmeraldas province of Ecuador.
By paying 40% above fair-trade market minimums, we help support regenerative agroforestry while obtaining the finest Arriba Nacional beans on earth.
